root_cause: The existing hourly evaluator calls revenue-learning-store reconciliation, which repeatedly selects the oldest 50 of 340 executed sales actions, then serially performs 50 individual RPCs. Netlify returned 502 for revenue-learning-evaluate with a correlated downstream Supabase 503. The serial loop is a source-level performance/fairness defect, not yet exclusive 503 causation.
fix: One SECURITY INVOKER service-role-only Postgres RPC processes at most 20 source actions atomically, prioritizing absent/least-recently-updated existing outcome obligations; existing stable obligation identities provide durable progress. Edge returns bounded receipt, rejects malformed receipts and other-tenant calls.
prevention_rule: No second cron/store, no blind timeouts/retries, no fabricated revenue; deploy reviewed migration before Edge source switch and verify the actual 503 rate, batch coverage, action outcome readback, backlogs and rollback.

expected_behaviors: at most twenty reconciliations in one atomic DB transaction
no customer value inferred from obligation coverage
